builds: Sequential per configuration; offline --no-restore, /m:4. No compiler during prebuilt lanes.

lanes.A: Core then Common prebuilt containers; each copied binaries, isolated TRX/temp observations/KR exports. MaxCpuCount=1 and MSTest Workers=1 override assembly parallelism.
lanes.B: Windows then frozen ControlMitigation prebuilt containers; original bitness/apartment. Generated projection sources copied/hash-checked, never regenerated. No Excel process.
lanes.C: Office and WASM managed prebuilt containers then Office JS, resolver and WASM Node. --test-concurrency=1, no npm install/build/server/browser.
lanes.D: Read/check-only inventory/catalog/metadata/resolver/help/Office audits then one Python discovery at a time. Temporary Help copies serialized. Fresh isolated semantic observations precede Common Python.

writers.isolation: Copied DLL execution base resolves inside each unique execution/sandbox; asserted before launch.
Unique BESHSTAT_KR_EXPORT_DIR and BESHSTAT_04A02_OBSERVATIONS per invocation.
Only lane D Python, one discovery at a time; no shared project compiler.
Serial after lanes; MkDocs site under own run only; validators check-only.

coverage: Exact applicable original verifier commands adapted to build-once isolated prebuilt invocations; original verifier remains immutable. No TestResults/Codex or old reports reused.
resource_scope: OS root-command CPU/peak working set only; child/testhost aggregate memory not measured. No psutil installation. Four command roots plus bounded testhost infrastructure; no claim of four total operating-system PIDs.
ports: Selected Node tests are file/unit suites; no browser/manual server process authorized. Unknown writers serialized.
timeouts: Only current run-owned live Popen tree may be killed; abort receipt completed=false, no pass substitution. Every launched future collected even on another lane failure.
fixture_readers: Core and Legacy project-relative TestData are copied/hash-checked into each isolated bin-local TestData directory; original bin-local fixture priority retained. No fixture regeneration.
observation_writers: Frozen C02 full-suite optional writer left unset, matching the accepted earlier verifier; it only permits C02-named roots. Semantic-only 15-case probe explicitly enables a unique 04A24 observations directory; Common Python uses that directory.

pilot_setup_corrections.Core: Initial copied Core container lacked project-relative fixtures: 71 setup failures; final Core full suite requalified after read-only fixture copying.
pilot_setup_corrections.Common: Initial full-suite C02 optional observation writer triggered four frozen prefix guards; unset only optional full-suite writer and requalify the entire Common suite. No old assertion changed.
pilot_setup_corrections.affected: Debug portable lane A only; other completed full Debug lanes retained. Release uses corrected runner. All failed receipts retained, no product/compiled-test change or rebuild required.
